def transform(g):
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    counts=Counter(v for row in g for v in row)
    bg=counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    wall_cols=[c for c in range(w) if all(g[r][c]==2 for r in range(h))]
    wall=wall_cols[0]
    obj=Counter(v for row in g for v in row if v not in (bg,2,8))
    color=obj.most_common(1)[0][0]
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==color]
    lo=min(c for r,c in pts); hi=max(c for r,c in pts)
    if wall<lo: shift=wall+1-lo
    elif wall>hi: shift=wall-1-hi
    else: shift=0
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for r,c in pts: out[r][c]=bg
    for r,c in pts: out[r][c+shift]=color
    newlo,newhi=lo+shift,hi+shift
    stripe=newhi+1 if wall<newlo else newlo-1
    for r in range(h): out[r][stripe]=8
    return out

src='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    wall = next(c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 2 for r in range(h)))
    object_color = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (background, 2, 8)).most_common(1)[0][0]
    points = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == object_color]
    left = min(c for r, c in points)
    right = max(c for r, c in points)
    if wall < left:
        shift = wall + 1 - left
    else:
        shift = wall - 1 - right
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, c in points:
        out[r][c] = background
    for r, c in points:
        out[r][c + shift] = object_color
    moved_left, moved_right = left + shift, right + shift
    stripe = moved_right + 1 if wall < moved_left else moved_left - 1
    for r in range(h):
        out[r][stripe] = 8
    return out
'''
